t: How to Add Author(s) to The Blog Builder
html:
Blog Authors in Eleva allow you to assign author profiles to blog posts. Each profile can include an author name, photo, description, and social media links. You can create multiple authors and select the appropriate author when publishing or updating posts. 

This article explains how to create author profiles and assign them to blog posts.

TABLE OF CONTENTS

  • What Are Blog Authors in Eleva?
  • Key Benefits of Blog Authors
  • Author Profile Settings
  • How to add authors to the blog builder?
  • Frequently Asked Questions

What Are Blog Authors in Eleva?

Blog Authors are profiles used to identify the people or contributors associated with your blog content. You can manage author profiles from Blog Settings and assign them to individual posts.

Key Benefits of Blog Authors

Author profiles help you organize blog content and provide readers with information about its contributors.

  • Author Attribution: Identify the author associated with each blog post.

  • Customizable Profiles: Add author photos, descriptions, and social media links.

  • Multiple Authors: Create profiles for different contributors without an author creation limit.

  • Flexible Assignment: Select or update the author associated with a blog post.

Author Profile Settings

Each author profile contains information used to identify and describe the contributor. These details can be configured when creating an author.

FieldDescription
Author NameName of the blog contributor.
Author PhotoProfile image, with a maximum supported file size of 10 MB.
Image Alt TextAlternative text describing the author photo.
Social PagesLinks to the author's social media profiles.
Author DescriptionA short biography or description of the author.

How to add authors to the blog builder?

Authors must be created in Blog Settings before they can be selected for blog posts. Once created, their profiles become available for assignment.

1. Click on "Sites" > Blogs > Settings (cog)

2. Click on "Author" tab located on the left side > "+ Add new author". Add your author name, photo, image alt text, social pages, and author description > Click on "+ Create Author" once you are ready

Note - 

1. Recommended size for author photo is 512px * 512px no bigger than 10MB.

2. There is no limit on Author Creation

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is an author required when publishing a blog post?

A: Yes. Selecting an author is part of the required blog post details in Eleva.

Q: Can I create author profiles for contributors who do not have a Eleva account?

A: Author profiles are created through Blog Settings. The documented process does not require selecting an existing Eleva user.

Q: Can I change the author of a published blog post?

A: Yes. Open the post using Update Post, select Update Settings, change the author, and publish the changes.

Q: What is the maximum supported author image size?

A: The maximum supported author image file size is 10 MB.

Q: Is there a limit to how many authors I can create?

A: No. Eleva's Blog Builder documentation does not specify a limit on author creation.
